_comment: itch.io pushes. Each game lists, per release variant, the 'user/page:channel' entries it is pushed to (one zip can go to several pages). Needs a repository secret named BUTLER_API_KEY (itch.io > Settings > API keys). A variant listed under 'unpushed' is built but has no page. Entries left as REPLACE_ME are skipped. Check with: node tools/check-itch-config.mjs. After a channel's first push, tick 'This file will be played in the browser' on that upload on the itch.io page, once.
